newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador bank liquidity down 0.58 pct on July 11.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador bank liquidity down 0.58 pct on July 11.

text.p: Ecuador's Central Bank said Tuesday liquidity in the banking system fell 0.58 percent or 118 million sucres to 20.06 billion sucres in the week to July 11.
At the end of June, bank liquidity stood at 19.80 billion sucres.
Total liquidity in the bank sector ended 1996 at 16.99 billion sucres, up 35.8 percent from 1995.
